adds: (1) Motion Reel engine fixes: type.js sets dir=auto and normal letter-spacing on RTL lines (Arabic word reveals); beats.py sets NUMBA_CPU_NAME=generic on Windows (avoids CPU-specific native crashes in librosa/numba).
